note: Emma Wood State Beach North Beach: a row of self-contained-only RV pull-outs on the old coast road along the beach, 2 mi west of Ventura at the south end of the Rincon Parkway. The Union Pacific line and US-101 run right behind the sites (noisy), and high tides can close the campground. --Claude
